1. Overview

1.1 Requirements Addressed

SRS RequirementAPI Endpoint(s)
FR-001 Candidate RegistrationPOST /recr/auth/register
FR-016 Employer RegistrationPOST /recr/auth/register
FR-002 LoginPOST /recr/auth/login
FR-003 Browse JobsGET /recr/jobs
FR-004 Submit ApplicationPOST /recr/applications
FR-008 Review ApplicationsGET /recr/hr/applications
FR-017 Post JobPOST /recr/employer/jobs

1.2 API Principles

  • RESTful design
  • JSON request/response
  • Versioned via URL path (/v1/)
  • Stateless (JWT authentication)
  • Role-based endpoints: /candidate/, /hr/, /employer/

1.3 Authentication

All endpoints require JWT Bearer token unless marked as Public. The JWT includes the user's role.

Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

// JWT Payload includes:
{
  "sub": "user_id",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "role": "candidate" | "hr" | "employer"
}

5. Endpoints

5.1 Authentication (All Roles)

POST /recr/auth/register (Public) FR-001, FR-016

Register a new user account. Supports two roles: candidate and employer.

Cross-module dependency: RECR Service calls AUTH Service to create the user account (email, password, role). AUTH returns user_id + JWT token. RECR then creates the recruitment-specific profile (candidate or employer) in recr_db.

Flow Summary

  1. Frontend sends registration request to RECR Service
  2. RECR validates input, calls AUTH Service to create user account
  3. AUTH checks email availability, hashes password, creates user with role, generates JWT
  4. RECR creates profile (candidate or employer) in recr_db
  5. RECR publishes user.registered event to Event Bus
  6. RECR returns 201 Created with user profile + JWT token
Figure: UC-01 Register Account - Cross-Module Sequence (RECR → AUTH → RECR DB)

phonestringNoValid phone format (e.g., +84xxx or 09xxxxxxx)Phone number

Error Responses

409 Conflict — Email already registered:

}

400 Bad Request — Validation error:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Invalid input data",
    "details": [
      { "field": "email", "message": "Invalid email format" },
      { "field": "password", "message": "Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and number" },
      { "field": "company_name", "message": "Company name is required for employer registration" }
    ]
  }
}

400 Bad Request — Invalid role:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_ROLE",
    "message": "Role must be 'candidate' or 'employer'. HR accounts are created by admin."
  }
}

503 Service Unavailable — AUTH module unreachable:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
    "message": "Registration service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later."
  }
}

Business Rules

RuleDescription
BR-AUTH-01Email must be unique across the entire system (checked by AUTH module)
BR-AUTH-02Password is hashed by AUTH module (bcrypt, 12 rounds) — RECR never stores plain text
BR-RECR-01Candidate registration creates recr_candidates record linked to recr_users
BR-RECR-02Employer registration creates recr_employers record linked to recr_users
BR-RECR-03HR accounts are created by admin only — self-registration not allowed for HR role
BR-RECR-04Registration is atomic: if AUTH succeeds but RECR profile creation fails, AUTH account is rolled back
BR-RECR-05user.registered event is published after successful registration (async, non-blocking)

POST /recr/auth/login (Public) FR-002

Login with email and password. Returns JWT token with role claim and user profile.

Cross-module dependency: RECR Service calls AUTH Service to verify credentials. AUTH checks email, compares password hash, verifies account status, and generates JWT. RECR then fetches recruitment-specific profile from recr_db.

Flow Summary

  1. Frontend sends login request to RECR Service
  2. RECR validates input, calls AUTH Service to authenticate
  3. AUTH finds user by email, compares password hash (bcrypt)
  4. AUTH checks account is active (not locked, not deleted)
  5. AUTH generates JWT token with role claim
  6. RECR fetches profile (candidate/employer) from recr_db
  7. RECR returns 200 OK with user profile + JWT token
Figure: UC-02 Login - Cross-Module Sequence (RECR → AUTH → RECR DB)

Request Body

FieldTypeRequiredValidationDescription
emailstringYesValid email format, max 255 charsRegistered email address
passwordstringYesMin 1 char (validation done by AUTH)Plain text password
{

  "password": "SecurePass123"
}

Error Responses

401 Unauthorized — Invalid credentials:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
    "message": "Email or password is incorrect"
  }
}

403 Forbidden — Account locked (too many failed attempts):

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ACCOUNT_LOCKED",
    "message": "Account locked due to too many failed login attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes or reset your password."
  }
}

403 Forbidden — Account inactive:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ACCOUNT_INACTIVE",
    "message": "Account has been deactivated. Please contact support."
  }
}

400 Bad Request — Validation error:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Invalid input data",
    "details": [
      { "field": "email", "message": "Invalid email format" },
      { "field": "password", "message": "Password is required" }
    ]
  }
}

429 Too Many Requests — Rate limited:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMITED",
    "message": "Too many login attempts. Please try again later."
  }
}

Business Rules

RuleDescription
BR-AUTH-10Email is case-insensitive — John@Example.com matches john@example.com
BR-AUTH-11Password is verified via bcrypt hash comparison (12 rounds)
BR-AUTH-12After 5 consecutive failed attempts, account is locked for 15 minutes
BR-AUTH-13JWT token expires in 24 hours (configurable via AUTH module)
BR-AUTH-14JWT payload includes: sub (user_id), email, role, iat, exp
BR-RECR-10Login returns recruitment-specific profile (candidate/employer/hr) based on role
BR-RECR-11Employer profile includes is_verified status for trust indicator
BR-RECR-12Failed login attempt is logged via LOG module for audit trail

5.2 Candidate Endpoints

GET /recr/jobs FR-003

Browse job listings. Public endpoint (no auth required).

Query Params: search, location, salary_min, employment_type, page, limit

POST /recr/applications FR-004

Submit job application. Requires candidate role.

Request:

{
  "job_id": 1,
  "cover_letter": "I am interested in this position..."
}

GET /recr/candidate/applications FR-005

View my applications. Requires candidate role.

PATCH /recr/candidate/profile FR-006

Update profile. Requires candidate role.

POST /recr/candidate/resume FR-007

Upload resume. Requires candidate role. Max 10MB.

5.3 HR Endpoints

GET /recr/hr/applications FR-008

Review applications. Requires hr role.

Query Params: job_id, status, page, limit

PATCH /recr/hr/applications/:id/status FR-009

Update application status. Requires hr role.

POST /recr/hr/interviews FR-010

Schedule interview. Requires hr role.

Request:

{
  "application_id": 1,
  "interviewer_id": 201,
  "scheduled_at": "2026-08-05T14:00:00Z",
  "duration_minutes": 60,
  "location": "Meeting Room A",
  "meeting_link": "https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij"
}

POST /recr/hr/evaluations FR-011

Submit evaluation. Requires hr role.

POST /recr/hr/offers FR-012

Create offer. Requires hr role.

GET /recr/hr/pipeline FR-014

View recruitment pipeline. Requires hr role.

GET /recr/hr/reports FR-015

Generate reports. Requires hr role.

5.4 Employer Endpoints

POST /recr/employer/jobs FR-017

Create job listing. Requires employer role.

Request:

{
  "title": "Senior Software Engineer",
  "description": "We are looking for a senior engineer...",
  "department": "Engineering",
  "location": "Ho Chi Minh City",
  "salary_min": 20000000,
  "salary_max": 40000000,
  "employment_type": "full_time",
  "requirements": [
    { "type": "skill", "description": "5+ years Node.js", "is_mandatory": true }
  ]
}

GET /recr/employer/jobs FR-018

List my jobs. Requires employer role.

PATCH /recr/employer/jobs/:id FR-018

Update job listing. Requires employer role.

GET /recr/employer/jobs/:id/applicants FR-019

View applicants. Requires employer role.

PATCH /recr/employer/jobs/:id/submit FR-020

Submit for HR approval. Requires employer role.

GET /recr/employer/analytics FR-021

View analytics. Requires employer role.

6. Pagination

All list endpoints support offset pagination.

GET /recr/jobs?page=2&limit=20

7. Webhook Events

EventDirectionProtocolDescription
user.registeredOutboundRabbitMQNew user registered (candidate or employer)
application.submittedOutboundRabbitMQCandidate submits application
interview.scheduledOutboundRabbitMQHR schedules interview
offer.sentOutboundRabbitMQHR sends offer letter
candidate.hiredOutboundRabbitMQCandidate accepts offer
job.submitted_for_approvalOutboundRabbitMQEmployer submits job for approval
